column1: # Reference databases published on Zenodo, read by "main-prokfinder.sh setup" (lib/common.sh: pf_registry_*).
# TAB-separated. HOST and RECORD give the URL https://<HOST>/records/<RECORD>/files/<FILE>?download=1.
# PACKAGE: database, table format (PF_REFDB_FORMAT_<DB> of the code that reads it), file name, MD5.
# Test record on the Zenodo sandbox (it has no definitive DOI and can be deleted): when the databases are published on
# zenodo.org, change only HOST, RECORD and the MD5 of the packages.
